Revenue grew by 16.4% to $2.8 billion during the quarter.
Operating margin improved to 24.6% as production became more efficient.
Net income increased by 21% to $430 million.
Operating cash flow strengthened to $610 million.
Customer orders expanded across the company's main product categories.
Subscription revenue rose as more existing customers renewed their contracts.
The company reduced its net debt while increasing its cash balance.
Demand for the new service exceeded management's initial expectations.
Management raised its full-year revenue guidance following the strong quarter.
The business expects continued profitable growth over the coming year.
